title: Tuko Salaad & Adhkaar v3.0.2
changelog: Shaashadda Salaadda Hadda Lagu Jiraa (Active Prayer): Marka aadaanku dhaco, shaashaddu waxay si toos ah u haysanaysaa salaadda hadda lagu jiro (sida Cisha) ilaa inta waqtiga salaadda iyo aqinku ka dhamaanayaan, halkii ay markiiba ugu boodi lahayd Subax.
Tirinta Ka Dhiman Aqinka (Iqama Countdown): Waxaa la arkayaa waqtiga ka dhiman aqinka iyo batoonka degdegga ah ee '✓ Waan Tukaday'.
